subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should the read tool get a narrow binary-document fallback now, or should this issue wait for broader document parsing/provider-native file work?
rationale: Current source still has the token-waste behavior, but related issues propose richer document extraction and provider-native forwarding, and the only open narrow PR is conflicting.

options.title: Land narrow fallback
options.body: Review, repair, or replace the linked guard PR so known PDF/Office document reads return a clear fallback message instead of decoded bytes.

options.title: Fold into broader document work
options.body: Keep this issue open only as context for broader document attachment/provider-native file architecture and close the conflicting guard PR.

recommendation.title: Land narrow fallback
recommendation.body: Review, repair, or replace the linked guard PR so known PDF/Office document reads return a clear fallback message instead of decoded bytes.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame/log for both read-tool files points to steipete’s source-restoration commit, and local history lacks a deeper owner trail.
